status: v2 (22 Nov 2026): clusters, summaries, numbers. Draft: Aditya reviews.
setting: Invented methods for large language models, tested on invented models and invented benchmarks in invented evaluation studies. Tasks, metrics and evaluation settings (zero-shot, few-shot, fine-tuned) are real concepts; model names, method names, benchmark names, authors and results are invented.

words.paper_kind: a critical survey of language model research
words.source_kinds: evaluation studies and the methods and earlier studies they assess
words.framework_section: Background on the Methods and Benchmarks

method.about: an invented method for language models

parts.type: what the method is in 1-2 plain words, e.g. prompting, adapter, decoding

attrs.summary: asks the model to list the sub-questions of a question and answer them in order before giving the final answer

parts.size: the parameter count as a short code, e.g. 7B, 13B, 70B

attrs.summary: a decoder-only model trained on web text and code, instruction-tuned

parts.code: a short task code, e.g. QA, Math, Code

attrs.summary: questions that need two or three facts from different paragraphs; answers are short spans

study.about: an invented evaluation study, named by its first author and year

attrs.summary: compares the method with plain prompting on the full test set, same decoding settings for both

reports_gain.meaning: the study reports that the method raised the model's score on the benchmark over the baseline

reports_no_gain.meaning: the study reports no clear difference from the baseline score on the benchmark for the method

reports_drop.meaning: the study reports that the method lowered the model's score on the benchmark below the baseline

fails_to_replicate.meaning: the study re-ran an earlier study's setup and did not get its reported result

confusable_note: DRAFT for review: a gain within run-to-run noise (one seed, no error bars) is often written as a gain; for a metric where lower is better (error rate, perplexity) a fall is a gain; a gain on one benchmark split with a drop on another reads as gain, drop or no gain.
real_names_note: Real names that invented entities must not use (whole words, any case; world.check). Empty until Aditya approves the sources for this list.

questions.text: Which methods raised the benchmark score in {s}?
Which studies found that {o} raised the benchmark score, and which did not?

world_notes: Make 4-6 invented methods in 1-3 families (e.g. prompting, fine-tuning, retrieval, decoding), 2-3 invented models, 2-3 invented benchmarks, and enough studies (years 2019-2026) that each paper has its own mix. Every name is invented: no real model, benchmark, dataset, lab or company names (no GPT, Llama, Qwen, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, BERT, T5, MMLU, GSM8K, HumanEval, BIG-bench, HellaSwag, SQuAD, ImageNet, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta etc.). Each study evaluates on one model and one benchmark (attrs). A study may only fail to replicate an EARLIER study. Plant disagreements: two studies on the same benchmark with opposite findings for the same method.
cluster_note: All methods, models, benchmarks and studies of this cluster belong to ONE research area within the cluster topic: make the benchmarks' tasks and the methods' families fit that area.
